decision: For expressions such as [100] from [367], [123] from [367], and analogous cases, 367 is the Atlas paper ID and the inner number is an internal reference number in paper 367; internal numbers must not be promoted to Atlas IDs.
PI-MPN is a valid paper-associated computational resource for Atlas paper 27 and the repository also contains dataset material; retain both code/resource and dataset relationships.
DeepXDE has a direct association with Atlas paper 234; Atlas papers 367 and 495 are secondary-review mentions only.

The source URL https://github.com/fashli/Delta-PINNs is incorrect. The correct repository for Atlas paper 312 is https://github.com/fsahli/Delta-PINNs. Preserve CR000021 as the original source observation/invalid alias and use CR000184 as the canonical resource identity for paper 312 in Stage 2.

CNNforCFD is not a PINN implementation, but it is code associated with an Atlas paper and should remain in the computational-resources registry because adjacent/non-PINN research code may be useful for PINN research and development.
PyTorch is not a PINN implementation. Retain it as a supporting framework/library and make it eligible for the future Frameworks & Libraries view.

The maziarraissi/PINNs repository is mentioned by multiple Atlas papers; Stage 2 must inspect each paper separately to determine which relationships are direct/original and which are secondary mentions.
Atlas paper 701 cites this code/resource as its internal reference 32. Only 701 is the Atlas ID.

https://github.com/NeuroDiffGym/neurodiffeq is the correct repository for Atlas paper 745. Other NeuroDiffEq owner/name variants are secondary-source mentions and must be checked at paper level in Stage 2 before relationship consolidation.

Paper 778 explicitly points to the JeongsLee GitHub profile as the location of source code and trained results. Keep the profile itself as the paper-associated resource. Individual repositories discovered under the profile must not be attributed to paper 778 unless Stage 2 verifies that specific relationship.
PICNN repeated source occurrences are correctly collapsed to one resource identity.
PINNs_BuckleyLeverett repeated identical source occurrences are correctly collapsed to one resource identity.

The HamidrezaEiv GitHub profile is a useful profile-level resource containing multiple PINN/operator-learning/related repositories. Keep the profile in the registry without inventing an Atlas-paper relationship.
fsahli/Delta-PINNs is the canonical Delta-PINNs repository and should inherit the Atlas paper 312 relationship from the invalid source alias CR000021 during Stage 2 materialization.

MULTIPINN is a PINN framework/library and should remain in the registry even without a current Atlas-paper mapping. The linked ScienceDirect paper is a candidate for later Atlas consideration, not a current Atlas relationship.
